Subject: Intro & next steps for Contoso offer onboarding

Hi Lauren / Jonas,

Thanks for the runbook you shared in the intake form — excited to get Redwood live in the Azure Marketplace for Contoso. To keep things moving on our side, below is a compact list of next steps we usually run through for publisher onboarding and technical validation: 

- Create/verify Publisher Account (publisher tenant ID + contact + billing owner)
- Provide a working test tenant or service account we can use to exercise the offer (SaaS API keys / ephemeral user)
- Submit an offer manifest (SaaS/Container/SKU details) and a reference deployment (ARM/Bicep or container image URI)
- Technical validation window: we typically require a 48–72 hour validation window with a test user and two sample flows
- Security proofs: TLS cert details, data handling doc, and any SOC2/Security attachments you can share

Attached is the Marketplace onboarding guide we usually send to publishers (azure-marketplace-onboarding-guide.pdf). Please reply with the publisher tenant ID, a preferred contact for publisher admin tasks, and an initial target week for validation.

If you want, we can block 60 minutes in the calendar later this week to walk validation engineers through the runtime.

Best,

Mike Hernandez
Principal PM, Azure Marketplace
Microsoft Corp.

Thanks Lauren — a few technical clarifications from the runtime/validation side so we can prep artifacts ahead of the validation window: 

1) Offer type: Are we submitting this as a SaaS offer (hosted by Redwood) or a VM/container-based marketplace VM offer? We plan for SaaS but want this explicit for manifest fields.
2) Authentication: Validation team needs a service account with OAuth client credentials (client_id + secret) and a sample SSO flow (SAML metadata or OIDC redirect URI) so they can spin up end-to-end tests.
3) Network: Which egress ports are required? Do we depend on any inbound hooks to Contoso networks? Provide IP ranges if there are firewall rules.
4) Data residency/regions: Which Azure regions will the offer be available in? We need region-scoped manifests (eu, us west, etc.) if telemetry/kv bindings vary.
5) Runtime image sizes: For container offers, please confirm max image layers and compressed size (some marketplace validators have limits).
6) Telemetry and logs: Provide a sample log bundle or a short run of an API call we can replay — this helps speed validation.

I attached a runtime-compat-matrix.csv to capture the pieces (happy to fill if someone from infra can drop the values). If we can get those pieces by EOD Friday (2026-06-18), we can lock the 06/23 validation slot and reduce back-and-forth during the live window.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Senior Engineering Manager, Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Mike Hernandez <mike.hernandez@microsoft.com>

Subject: Re: Intro & next steps for Contoso offer onboarding

Hi all — great questions, thanks Markus. Answers below and next steps.

- Offer type: SaaS offer is fine and preferred for this flow. Submit the SaaS offer manifest with the SaaS API endpoint and we will validate end-to-end.
- Authentication: OAuth2 client credentials is the recommended approach; SAML SSO is optional for publisher-managed admin console. Please provide an OAuth client (client_id + secret) scoped to a test tenant.
- Network: No inbound hooks to Contoso required. Egress: 443 outbound for API calls; if you rely on telemetry sinks in other regions, please list them.
- Regions: Please include uswest2 and northeurope in the manifest initially — we can expand after GA.
- Image sizes: Not applicable for SaaS, but for reference any container assets should be under 1.5GB compressed.
- Logs: A short sample of API request/response traces is sufficient.

Attachments: I've uploaded an offer-template.json and a validation-checklist.xlsx that mirror what our validation team will run through.

Next steps: 
1) Lauren: sign publisher agreement (we can send via DocuSign) — I will include a link in a follow-up email.
2) Redwood: provide OAuth test client + the completed runtime-compat-matrix.csv by 2026-06-18 EOD.
3) MS team: target validation window 2026-06-23 through 2026-06-26 (72 hours).
4) I will send calendar invite and share a temporary validation tenant.

DocuSign link (publisher agreement): https://docusign.com/ABC123-Contoso-Redwood-Offer
Validation workspace: https://microsoft.sharepoint.com/teams/marketplace/validation/Contoso-Redwood

Looking forward — send the artifacts when ready and I will confirm the calendar slot.

Cheers,

Mike Hernandez
Principal PM, Azure Marketplace
